done_when: The worker brief tells workers to run tests in the foreground, never end a turn while a command still runs in the background, and commit their work before the turn ends; forge work prints a plain warning naming the uncommitted files when a round ends with changes left uncommitted; a test runs forge work with a worker stub that leaves an uncommitted change and sees the warning
why: Claude workers start the test suite in the background and end their turn before committing, so the review sees an empty branch
